raw_segments.text: Tell me now, Omuse's that dwell on Olympus, who was the first of the archives to bear
away blood-stained spoils after Neptune Lord of the Earthquake had turned the fortune of
Ajax's son of Telamon was first to wound Heidius son of Geidius, captain of the staunch
Antilachus killed Faustus and Mermerus, while Mirian slew Morys and Hippocian, Tuser also
The son of Atreus then wounded Hyperrhena Shepherd of his people, in the flank, and
the bronze point made his entrails gush out as it tore in among them.
On this, his life came hurrying out of him at the place where he had been wounded, and
his eyes were closed in darkness.
Ajax's son of Oilius killed more than any other, for there was no man so fleet as he
would pursue flying foes when Jove had spread panic among them.
